from pathlib import Path
import re, hashlib, json
p = Path('docs/downsight/golden-d-v2/README.md')
doc = p.read_text()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', doc):
    name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
    path = p.parent / name
    assert path.is_file(), name
    if anchor:
        a, b = re.fullmatch(r'L(\d+)-L(\d+)', anchor).groups()
        assert 0 < int(a) <= int(b) <= len(path.read_text().splitlines()), target
for nav in [Path('README.md'), Path('docs/downsight/GOLDEN_D_2D_zh.md')]:
    assert any((nav.parent/link).resolve() == p.resolve() for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',nav.read_text()))
m=read('configs/golden_d.current.json')
for f in m['locked_files']:
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
assert m['method_id']=='golden-d-2d-v2'
protocol=read(m['protocol'])
assert (protocol['sigma_px_fixed'],protocol['metric_huber_delta'],protocol['metric_loss_weight'], protocol['shoulder_weight'])==(8,2.5,0.01,0.25)
assert (protocol['head_position_sigma_m'],protocol['head_position_weight'],protocol['head_rotation_weight'],protocol['pose_prior_weight'],protocol['minimum_observed_joint_z_m'])==(0.015,0.01,0,0.0008,0.0001)
assert protocol['budgets']==[20000] and protocol['checkpoint_steps']==20

    print(key, values)

    assert match,line
    edges.add(match.groups())
assert set([('J','L'),('J','R'),('E','O'),('O','U'),('U','P'),('P','J'),('U','S')])<=edges
